records.name: Easy Build and Rhythm Run — retained 35 m teaching context

mechanics.start: Still comfortable bilateral standing start with relaxed natural arms and a known straight route. No rolling, three-point, falling or reactive start is added.
mechanics.build: Build smoothly over 0–10 m: easy context about 2/10 toward 3/10; independently qualified modest-intent context about 2/10 toward 4/10. No maximal start or forced early upright posture.
mechanics.rhythm: Retain relaxed selected effort over 10–20 m: about 3/10 easy or 4/10 in the qualified context. Natural coordinated running and arms; no fly threshold, timed result or maximal second half.
mechanics.runoff: Reduce speed gradually through 20–35 m. Do not force an abrupt stop at 35 m or shorten runoff for the clock. If actual effort no longer fits the retained protected route, hold/reduce, explicitly reconfigure or defer.
mechanics.exitReturn: Exit by the declared protected path, then use the separate one-way outside return and full recovery. Return turns and staging are logistics, not extra technical or cutting repetitions.
mechanics.contactRule: Count every attempt, including partial/faulted work. Record actual build/rhythm/runoff/exit/return, intended/reported effort, contacts, distance, time and response. Zero prescribed jump-drill repetitions is not zero cyclic running flight, contacts or impact; actual contact totals remain null until observed.
